## AuthConfig.background property

Background styles.

**Signature:**

```typescript
background: ComposableStyles | ComposableStyles[] | null;
```

## Remarks

Providing `null` will hide the background. The format examples from [AuthConfig.logo](./foundation-auth.authconfig.logo.md) apply here too. See also [https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/background](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/background) for more information.

## Example

Setting a custom background image

```ts
background: `
    :host {
        background-image: url(${customBGImport});
    }
`,
```
